author: blekek.k
title: Illustrators needed for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. We're looking for artists that draws: Anime / manga style illustrations; Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration; Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork; Semi-realistic illustrations; and any other art styles. Comment if you're interested or DM me directly! Follow-up (09/21/26): Thanks you guys for reaching out. I'm surprised by the amount of people who are interested. I'll be checking your portfolio. For the ones who haven't sent in their portfolio, you can provide a link where I can see your previous works. Contact: comment on the post or DM @blekek.k.

author: bee.chaoticcore
title: Paid character/concept art for fantasy series
content: ARTISTS + ANIMATORS OF THREADS! I'm a writer developing an adult fantasy animated series and I'm looking for artists to help bring it to life! I'm starting small, but this is paid work. I'm looking to commission character/concept art first and grow from there. Fantasy artists/animators—drop your work + rates!! Contact: reply on the post with work and rates, or DM @bee.chaoticcore.

author: veliraiyawrites
title: Seeking fantasy map designer and character illustrator
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely doesn't have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you're a fantasy author recommending someone you've personally worked with because I know the bots are about to find me. See the next posts for more details on what I'm looking for with each! Contact: reply on the thread or DM @veliraiyawrites.
